title: What are Deepfake videos?
body:
What are Deepfake videos?

Deepfake is a video where one person's face is replaced with another's using a computer.

This is very dangerous:
• Scammers can make a video where you say something you didn't say
• Can deceive your friends
• Use for blackmail

It's like a mask that can't be removed!

✅ ALADDIN Premium detects fake videos and warns.
